title: Aim-Tune
summary: Finds your ideal mouse sensitivity with a quick in-browser flick and tracking test, then gives the result in cm/360 for any game.
highlights: Separates misses into ahead of and behind the target to reduce reaction-time noise
Recommended range shown on a ruler, with an A/B feel test

title: Yaw-Match
summary: Converts mouse sensitivity between games so your aim feels the same everywhere. Works with cm/360, eDPI and FOV, and runs entirely in the browser.
highlights: Games database with yaw values, sources and a trust label for each game
Shareable links and copyable console/config lines

title: RC Car Telemetry System
summary: My capstone project: real-time telemetry and remote control for an RC car, split across an Arduino, a Raspberry Pi and a PC client over TCP/IP and USB serial.
highlights: Raspberry Pi reads 6 IR sensors and 4 wheel encoders and streams low-latency telemetry over TCP
Post-session dashboard charts speed profiles and encoder timelines from SQLite

title: Autonomous Highway Driving (DQN)
summary: A reinforcement learning agent that drives through dense highway traffic, keeping a good speed while avoiding collisions.
highlights: Custom reward balancing speed, lane efficiency and safety

title: Google Maps Business Finder
summary: Collects business data from Google Maps for a keyword and location, then enriches it with emails and social links found on each business's website.
highlights: FastAPI backend with live progress over WebSocket
Runs locally with Docker Compose (frontend and backend as separate services)

title: German Traffic Sign Classifier
summary: Recognizes German traffic signs with classic computer vision and machine learning (HOG features with SVM and KNN), without neural networks.
highlights: Full preprocessing pipeline and HOG feature extraction with OpenCV
SVM and KNN compared with confusion matrices

title: The Last Ember
summary: An atmospheric 2D survival game about keeping a small campfire alive, as a metaphor for holding on to motivation.

title: Tri-Jump
summary: A vertical-climbing arcade game with physics-based jumps between rotating circles, procedural platform spawning and a camera that chases you upward.

title: Project Zomboid Mods
summary: Gameplay mods for Project Zomboid, such as Hope's Better Jams and Hope's Better Boulders.

title: Smart Restaurant Order System
summary: An extensible order-processing engine in Java 17 built around GoF patterns (Strategy, Factory, Observer) and SOLID principles, documented with UML class, sequence and use case diagrams.

title: Food Order System
summary: A meal ordering system for a single restaurant. Uses a queue for order processing and a tree for menu management.
